'''Noble Calder''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] who flew as part of [[Veerpal Squadron]]. He participated in the defence of the [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] ''[[Aremin]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="A Bitter Winter" />
